The '''Processional Way''' was the main boulevard leading from the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Once lined with statues of famous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], the road was reconstructed circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] without them. Beginning at a large public landing platform, the road terminated at the main entry staircase that led deep into the [[Great Hall (Jedi Temple)/Legends|Great Hall]]. Falling into disuse during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the road was once again rebuilt during the reign of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], beginning in the newly constructed [[Fellowship Plaza]].

==History==
Constructed sometime after the establishment of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the Processional Way was established by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the main road and access point to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order's]] headquarters on Coruscant. It was crowned by four statues&mdash;two [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Warrior Masters]] and two [[Jedi Consular|Sage Masters]]&mdash;and ended at four pylons with reliefs of the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]].<ref name="SWCL" /> This road would exist for the next thousand years, serving the Order through a long era of peace and growth. It wasn't until the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that Coruscant was threatened once more. By the time the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] discovered that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] was in control of both sides of the conflict, it was too late. Sidious' [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], led a [[501st Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] down the Processional Way and stormed the Temple, leaving it a burnt out ruin of its former self.<ref name="ROTS" /> With the Temple in the hands of the Sith and the newly established [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a landing platform was constructed at the foot of the entry stairs which were otherwise blocked off by debris.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

[[File:Swlegacy14p3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|With most of the Precinct hidden under newer construction, the new Processional Way was built as a bridge.]]

Although destroyed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] sometime after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Jedi Temple was [[New Jedi Temple|reconstructed]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in appreciation of the rebuilt [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order's]] efforts in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Leading from the newly installed [[Fellowship Plaza]], the road once more led up to the Temple, now a glimmering [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and stone pyramid.<ref name="LOTFO" /> It was here that a [[Force psychosis|maddened]] [[Jysella Horn]] would be captured by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] in [[43 ABY]], after succumbing to a strange and dangerous illness. As this plague grew worse within the ranks of the Order's Knights, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] ordered the Temple be [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|seized]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors as to prevent the spread of the psychotic Jedi. A standoff lasted outside on the Processional for several days, eventually resulting in withdrawal of the Mandalorians due to lack of public support.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

A century later, when the resurgent [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] overthrew the galactic government and the Order, the Coruscant Temple was converted into a [[Temple of the Sith]]. New buildings covered the roadway and the Temple Court, necessitating the construction of a [[Skybridge/Legends|skybridge]] spanning the chasm between nearby buildings and the Sith Pyramid.<ref name="Legacy 2006 14">[[Legacy (2006) 14|''Legacy'' (2006) 14]]</ref>
